stem: Which sentence states how the authors of each selection support their ideas?

options.label: A
options.text: The author of “A History of Fearlessness” uses first-person narration, while the author of “No Dream Is Impossible” provides a third-person historical overview.

options.label: B
options.text: The author of “A History of Fearlessness” depends on quotations from others, while the author of “No Dream Is Impossible” provides a first-person account of her life.

options.label: C
options.text: The author of “A History of Fearlessness” mainly references other articles, while the author of “No Dream Is Impossible” references experts in her field.

options.label: D
options.text: The author of “A History of Fearlessness” relies on his own insights and philosophies, while the author of “No Dream Is Impossible” provides a detailed chronology of her life.
